summary.text: SpaceX IPO fever dominates trading flows as retail and institutional money pours into the freshly public space giant. Options trading launch Tuesday promises to amplify speculation around the scarcity premium.

Zero-day expiration strategies on SPY showcase extreme risk appetite among retail traders seeking rapid scalping profits. This aggressive positioning reflects heightened market confidence despite elevated volatility.
Large bearish semiconductor bets signal growing concern over October correction risks, with traders positioning for economic deterioration despite current AI rally momentum.
